messages:
kai (AE): MarinerBank asked for a 2-week POC. Requirements: Okta SAML signed assertions, SCIM delta + bulk for ~150k users, RBAC group->role + attr rules, per-tenant DNS TXT verification, SCIM token rotation and audit retention. Also procurement wants a short hosted vs dedicated comparison. Any quick blockers?

priya (SE): We support SAML 2.0 signed assertions and metadata upload. SP & IdP initiated flows ok. We map SAML attributes into subject_id and a roles claim.

priya (SE): SCIM: RFC7644 compliant. PATCH + If-Match ETag supported. Default rate limit 12 req/s per tenant; Dedicated can be configured higher. Recommend Bulk endpoint for initial 150k seed. Soft-delete default 30 days, adjustable on Dedicated.

omar (Security): CMK on Dedicated/Private yes. Audit logs default 90 days, extendable. TLS 1.2+ required. We can provide SOC2 AOC under NDA. I'll prepare answers for their security questionnaire.

tess (Solutions): Procurement blurb draft: "Hosted eval: fastest to validate flows with logical tenant isolation and usage billing; limited CMK and no SLA during eval. Dedicated: isolated compute/networking, full CMK support, configurable retention and rate limits, SLA-backed availability; committed pricing typically starts ~$22k/mo depending on throughput."

infra-bot: Provisioned POC tenant 'marinerbank-poc' in us-west-2. Temporary SCIM token and SAML callback sent to kai via DM.

kai (AE): Thanks team. I'll request IdP metadata + seed CSV and attach the procurement blurb. Priya please add a short SCIM PATCH + If-Match example I can share.

priya (SE): Quick PATCH example (If-Match): curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/uid123" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" -H "If-Match: \"etag9\"" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":false}]}'

kai (AE): Perfect. I'll post kickoff invite for Mon 9am PT and attach these notes.
